settings.solarDiscrepancyNote: CRITICAL DATA AUDIT FLAG: The university's renewable energy publication reports approximately 800 units (kWh) daily generated by the Central Administration Building rooftop array, but simultaneously reports an annualized/monthly savings figure that does not mathematically reconcile with the stated daily capacity (800 kWh/day * 365 * ₹8.50 = ~₹24.8 Lakhs/year). ECHOTECH flags this discrepancy and uses the empirical 800 kWh/day generation baseline as reference while auditing actual financial yields.

actions.title: Admin Rooftop Solar Module Spray Wash & String Test
actions.interventionDetails: Demineralized high-pressure spray cleaning of 220 kWp rooftop array; thermal imaging on string inverters.
actions.currentReading: Array washed 50% - awaiting post-intervention generation log
actions.notes: Electrician team deployed morning 06:30. Inverter MPPT string 2 fuses replaced.

actions.title: Central Lawn Turf Irrigation Lateral Rupture Sealing
actions.interventionDetails: Excavated fractured 90mm schedule-40 PVC joint near Chancellery lawn; replaced with HDPE electrofusion coupling.
actions.currentReading: Verified: Daily irrigation stabilized at 264,000 Litres (normal design distribution)
actions.notes: Pressure test passed at 3.5 bar continuous hold. Verified leak eliminated.

actions.title: Cafeteria Waste Weigh-Back Scale & Compost Bin Expansion
actions.interventionDetails: Set up electronic platform scale at tray returns; build 2 additional brick-lined vermiculture pits with coconut coir and dry leaves.
actions.baselinePeriod: Surge: 238 kg/day food waste post-cultural event
actions.currentReading: Procurement approved for digital floor scale
actions.notes: Student volunteer green marshals briefing scheduled for Friday lunch hour.

actions.title: CSE Lab Automated Hibernate Script Deployment
actions.assignedTo: Dr. K. Sharma (Head of Systems & Networking)
actions.interventionDetails: Active Directory GPO policy deployed to 450 lab computers to force S3 sleep after 30 min idle past 21:00.
actions.baselinePeriod: Night baseline: 42 kW continuous idle draw
actions.currentReading: Script rolled out to Labs 1, 2, 3; testing wake-on-LAN for backups
actions.notes: Initial test showed 14 kW overnight drop in first 3 labs.
